Defina o papel: objetivo que dá para med: Define the role: a goal you can measure, context, and an example of your own.
Várias rodadas, lista de correções e pro: Several rounds, a list of corrections and a written procedure. The same mistake doesn't come back.
Modelo certo, cache, lote e conta acompa: The right model, cache, batching and a bill you keep an eye on. There are no miracles: you can only relax once the system runs right.
Four questions about the whole course.
Na comparação das três versões, qual é a: When you compare the three versions, what is the yardstick?
The length of the text in each version.
O tempo que a IA levou para responder em: How long the AI took to answer in each version.
A Medida da ficha de função, a mesma par: The Measure from the role sheet, the same for all three.
Uma régua só deixa a comparação justa. A: A single yardstick keeps the comparison fair. The Measure from the sheet tells you whether the result is good enough, in any version.
Qual é a ordem dos degraus do plano?: What is the order of the steps in the plan?
Qualquer ordem, porque os degraus são in: Any order, because the steps are independent.
A ficha aponta para a base de contexto;: The sheet points to the context base; the measure pins down the sheet's goal; the training uses the Measure; the cost test uses the trained procedure.

You need to learn to code.
